findings.title: panic on View error in render path
findings.message: The gallery view calls panic when View() returns an error. A failure in a rendering path crashes the whole demo app instead of being surfaced as status. The same pattern is used for the document list.
findings.suggestion: Return an error label node or set m.status instead of panicking.

findings.title: Activation compares against live mutable state
findings.message: The scope Activate closure and the query Change closure both capture s and read its mutable Items and Value when invoked. The Apply docs say events merge, but the guard compares against the live s.Value, so a queued selection of the already-selected scope is dropped silently. This is minor, but a stale view where Value was changed between View() and activation can also cause inconsistent behavior.
findings.suggestion: Document the live-state semantics, or compare against the Value captured at View time.
